description: Dated, sourced reporting on moving to and retiring in Italy, newest first. Filter by topic, by place (a comune's ISTAT code) or by dataset slug. Each entry has its URL, a Markdown URL for the full text, and the places and datasets it cites. Content is free to use provided you credit Expat Living Italy and link to the article.

include.description: Pass `archived` to include archived articles, flagged by `status`.

place.description: A comune's 6-digit ISTAT code (or a province sigla / region slug).

topic.description: One of: tax, residency-visas, costs-housing, healthcare, places, daily-life, data-method.

name: list_articles
title: List Expat Living Italy's articles
